achievements.name: Forsaken City
achievements.detail: Finish the opening chapter by crossing the ruined city and reaching the campsite above it.

achievements.name: Strawberry
achievements.detail: Pick up a strawberry and reach the far side of that room before losing it.

achievements.name: Old Site
achievements.detail: Clear the second chapter and rest at the campsite beyond the old ruins.

achievements.name: Celestial Resort
achievements.detail: Work through the dusty hotel in chapter three and exit onto the roof.

achievements.name: Mirror Temple
achievements.detail: Escape the dark temple of chapter five and return to open air.

achievements.name: Summit
achievements.detail: Pass every checkpoint of chapter seven and stand on the mountain's peak.

achievements.name: The Core
achievements.detail: Finish chapter eight by crossing both the hot and cold halves of the mountain's core.

achievements.name: Crystal Heart
achievements.detail: Find a crystal heart hidden away from a chapter's main climb.

achievements.name: B-Side
achievements.detail: Beat the harder cassette remix of any chapter from start to finish.

achievements.name: C-Side
achievements.detail: Clear a three-screen remix that unlocks after that chapter's B-side is done.

achievements.name: Farewell
achievements.detail: Enter the mountain's final extra chapter and follow it all the way to its last room.

achievements.name: Moon Berry
achievements.detail: In the final extra chapter, take the unmarked detour near the end and collect the strawberry waiting there.
